|death = {{ne|1000}}}}'''Joni Shagrin''' was an old warhand under the command of [[Gareth Bryne]]. He was formerly a Senior Bannerman of the [[Queen's Guards]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Joni Shagrin}}

== Appearance ==
He was a big man with thinning gray hair.

== Activities ==
He was escorting [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]] and [[Min Farshaw]] to Bryne's estates when he was ambushed by [[Logain Ablar]] and knocked unconscious.{{ref/book|5|1}} He set off with Gareth to track down Siuan when she broke her oath to Gareth. This led him all the way from [[Andor]] to [[Salidar]] where the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] were.

He was sent to [[Ebou Dar]] to help recruit men for the Rebel Aes Sedai army.

Assumingly, Joni remained with the Salidar Aes Sedai all the way up to the reunification of the [[White Tower]]. Approaching the [[Last Battle]], he started training the cavalry of the White Tower Guard together with [[Uno Nomesta]].

After the [[Shara]]ns arrived on the battlefield in [[Kandor]] and the forces of the White Tower had been pushed back to the border to [[Arafel]], Joni was killed while commanding a contingent of the White Tower Guard fighting for control over a river ford. He was mourned by his lord, who however stated that Joni had always wanted to die in battle.

Uno replaced him when he died.
